hypotheses.reasoning: Traffic is healthy until 22:45:45. At 22:45:55 template-svc starts getting 502/503 errors and 10s timeouts from the third-party email provider api.mailer.example (#143, #146, #151, #153). Its circuit breaker for that provider opens at a 93% failure rate (#159), and every half-open probe after that still fails with 503 (#180, #190), so the provider is still down. With the breaker open, template-svc fails fast with 503s. notification-svc's TemplateClient.render fails with 'circuit open' (#158 and others), and the gateway returns 503 on POST /v1/notify. Those lines show the impact, not the cause. I ruled out the alternatives: there are no deploys in the logs, the config reload (#149) changed 0 keys, the audit_log slow query (#135) is unrelated, and redis, notif-db and notif-worker all look healthy.
Another reading is that this is just a cascade from template-svc into notification-svc. But the fault starts at the external provider, so external_outage is the better label.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the mailer provider's status page or contact them about the api.mailer.example /v3/send outage. Fail over to a backup email provider if one is set up. Otherwise, take email sending out of the synchronous POST /v1/notify path: accept the request and queue the send for retry once the circuit closes. Leave the circuit breaker on so calls keep failing fast.
